stem.text: Carboxylic acids can be made by several different reactions.

items: The acid hydrolysis of $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CN}$ will make ethanoic acid.
The oxidation of $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{OH}$ will make butanoic acid.
The oxidation of $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CHO}$ will make propanoic acid.
